name: Minakuchi Tsuyu
source:
Sex: Female
Occupation: Housewife
Age: 63 years old

[url=/c163937]Yuza Minakuchi[/url]'s paternal grandmother, and a former ama diver. Born in the Taisho period. She has a relaxed and broad-minded nature, but her tendency not to concern herself with the finer details often makes those around her uneasy.
* * *
Although now retired due to health issues, she was one of the best ama divers on Kameshima — especially in her younger days, during which she had a fierce rivalry with [url=/c164209]Chie Toyama[/url], also know as Chie the Mermaid. Later years saw them reconcile, and they could often be seen talking and laughing together at the diver's hut while grilling their catches.
She lost her husband in the war when her son, [url=/c165732]Tosuke Minakuchi[/url], was 3 years old.

[From in-game profile]
